title: Expand the WEF Data Policy 2020-2021 public roster
summary: Recover additional members from the WEF-described 30-member Global Future Council on Data Policy using official WEF profiles and authoritative institutional biographies, classify evidence strength, and crossmatch exact identities against later Data Equity and Data Frontiers rosters.

selection_reason: The historical Data Policy roster is the least complete of the three comparison generations and therefore dominates carryover uncertainty.

data.target: WEF Global Future Council on Data Policy 2020-2021 public roster
data.query: Global Future Council on Data Policy 2020 2021 members roster World Economic Forum
data.research_question: How much of the WEF-described 30-member Data Policy council can be source-reconstructed, and which exact people recur in later data-governance councils?
objectives: Search exact council-name references in WEF person and agenda-contributor profiles.
Use authoritative institutional biographies for historical dates when WEF current profiles omit them.
Distinguish person membership from organization membership and publication participation.
Crossmatch exact identities against the fixed 2023-2024 Data Equity roster and current Data Frontiers roster.
selection_reason: Completing the oldest roster is prerequisite to reliable cross-term carryover counts.
